Destruction Derby 64.name: Destruction Derby 64
Destruction Derby 64.summary: Destruction Derby 64 is a racing game that combines high-speed competition with vehicular combat. Players race through 12 tracks while attempting to wreck opponents' cars for points, balancing the need for speed with strategic demolition. The game offers multiplayer support for up to four players and features various game modes, including traditional derbies, Capture the Flag, and arena battles. A variety of cars are available, with a special unlockable taxi vehicle serving as a reward for completing the game.
